afsluitInstructies.facebook: Request memorial status or have the account deleted via Meta's special memorial form. Death certificate required.
afsluitInstructies.instagram: Request memorial account or deletion via Instagram's next-of-kin form. Proof of death required.
afsluitInstructies.twitter: Request deactivation by next of kin via the privacy form. Death certificate and ID required.
afsluitInstructies.linkedin: Remove a deceased member's profile via the next-of-kin form. Verification required.
afsluitInstructies.tiktok: Delete account by next of kin via contact form. Proof of death required.
afsluitInstructies.snapchat: Next of kin can submit a removal request via the support form.
afsluitInstructies.google: Set up Inactive Account Manager or have the account deleted by next of kin. Google offers an extensive procedure including data access.
afsluitInstructies.microsoft: Next of kin can submit a request to close the account or request data via the 'Next of Kin' process.
afsluitInstructies.apple: Digital Legacy program or request for account closure. Apple requires a court order or death certificate.
afsluitInstructies.yahoo: Close account via next-of-kin request. Death certificate and ID required.
afsluitInstructies.ing: Contact the bank about the death. ING handles closure via branch or phone.
afsluitInstructies.rabobank: Report the death via branch or phone. Rabobank guides the settlement process.
afsluitInstructies.abnAmro: Report the death and arrange banking matters. ABN AMRO offers a dedicated bereavement team.
afsluitInstructies.sns: Report the death and have accounts settled via the branch.
afsluitInstructies.paypal: Close account after death by contacting PayPal customer service. Death certificate required.
afsluitInstructies.bolcom: Contact customer service to have the account closed.
afsluitInstructies.amazon: Close account via the support form. Next of kin must provide a death certificate.
afsluitInstructies.coolblue: Contact customer service for account removal.
afsluitInstructies.netflix: Cancel subscription and delete account via account settings or customer service.
afsluitInstructies.spotify: Close account via account settings or by contacting support.
afsluitInstructies.disney: Cancel subscription and delete account via account management.
afsluitInstructies.steam: Account transfer is officially not supported. Contact Steam Support.
afsluitInstructies.playstation: Close account via PlayStation Support. Death certificate required.
afsluitInstructies.xbox: Falls under Microsoft Next of Kin process. Close account via Microsoft Support.
afsluitInstructies.digid: DigiD is automatically revoked by the municipality after registration of death.
afsluitInstructies.mijnOverheid: Account is linked to DigiD and expires automatically after death.
afsluitInstructies.slack: Workspace administrator can deactivate the account. Contact the employer's IT department.
afsluitInstructies.zoom: Delete account via account settings or by the administrator.
